mechanism: A structural, gradual type system erased before runtime. `strict` is opt-in. The emitted JS has no residual types unless you emit runtime helpers by hand.
why: JS jobs needed static checking without abandoning the JS runtime or npm.
useWhen: Any JS codebase that can afford a compile step — which in 2026 is most product TS jobs.
price: Types are a lie the compiler told you; `as` and `any` punch holes; runtime is still JS.
